java11_diagnostic.source_context: The CI-enabled testUpdateWhenNearlyOutOfMemory launches MyChild with128MiB and ParallelGC. MyChild deliberately consumes memory via eatMemory(80), attempts an update, and expects a SQLException; the parent waits and validates persisted database rows. The source supports a connection to intentional memory pressure but does not establish that this exact uncaught background exception is an expected diagnostic.
